name: lil-ds41-flash
services:
  model:
    image: ghcr.io/local-inference-lab/vllm@sha256:f5f9efe1b10ec7b853a495e66b7dbf15ff54f62741e444dea0b44e16736a10a9
    container_name: lil-ds41-flash
    init: true
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: 32g
    restart: on-failure
    ulimits:
      memlock:
        soft: -1
        hard: -1
      stack:
        soft: 67108864
        hard: 67108864
    volumes:
    - lil-hf:/root/.cache/huggingface
    - lil-ds41-flash-runtime:/cache
    entrypoint:
    - /usr/local/bin/lil-serve
    command:
    - --profile
    - ds41-flash
    - --hardware
    - rtx-pro-6000-pcie
    - --
    - --cache-l1-gib
    - '512.0'
    - --cache-mode
    - lmcache
    - --no-cache-l2-enabled
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
          - driver: nvidia
            device_ids:
            - '0'
            - '1'
            - '2'
            - '3'
            capabilities:
            - gpu
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    environment:
    - HF_TOKEN
volumes:
  lil-hf:
    name: lil-hf
  lil-ds41-flash-runtime:
    name: lil-ds41-flash-runtime
x-lil-configurator:
  schema: lil-web-deployment/v1
  setup:
    image: karmic-kraken-beta-08edd314f7ee880c5cc29eb4692afc2aa7a2c51736c188335b655cdbf5ed6eea
    profile: ds41-flash
    options:
      cache-l1-gib: 512.0
      cache-mode: lmcache
      cache-l2-enabled: false
    environment: {}
    argv: []
    name: lil-ds41-flash
    gpus:
    - '0'
    - '1'
    - '2'
    - '3'
    restart: on-failure
  image_digest: ghcr.io/local-inference-lab/vllm@sha256:f5f9efe1b10ec7b853a495e66b7dbf15ff54f62741e444dea0b44e16736a10a9
  service_sha256: c732f84af0cbc5fa2996373443f788e18bd7dd31aea7b9aecb030e3051b191b3

What the container runs; for reading, not for pasting on a host without the image's environment.

/opt/venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main serve local-inference-lab/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-lossless-CSF \
  --async-scheduling \
  --attention-backend B12X \
  --block-size 256 \
  --compilation-config '{
    "cudagraph_mode": "FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"
  }' \
  --decode-context-parallel-size 1 \
  --decode-refill-target auto \
  --default-chat-template-kwargs '{
    "thinking": true,
    "reasoning_effort": "high"
  }' \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --enable-force-include-usage \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --enable-prompt-tokens-details \
  --enable-request-id-headers \
  --engram-config '{
    "cpu_offload": false,
    "table_memory": "ram",
    "disk_resident_scales": false,
    "projection_tp": false

  --generation-config vllm \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --jit-monitor-mode warn \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --kv-transfer-config '{
    "kv_connector": "LMCacheMPConnector",

    "kv_role": "kv_both",

    "kv_connector_extra_config": {

      "lmcache.mp.mp_transfer_mode": "engine_driven",
      "lmcache.mp.mq_timeout": 60.0,
      "lmcache.mp.heartbeat_interval": 10.0
    }
  }' \
  --linear-backend b12x \
  --load-format mxfp4_csf \
  --max-cudagraph-capture-size 128 \
  --max-model-len -1 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \
  --max-num-seqs 32 \
  --max-parallel-prefills 1 \
  --moe-backend b12x \
  --override-generation-config '{
    "temperature": 1.0,
    "top_p": 0.95
  }' \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --port 8000 \
  --prefill-compute-share 0.4 \
  --prefill-policy round-robin \
  --prefill-schedule-interval 1 \
  --quantization mxfp4_csf \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --revision 9c60bcbf1670e06f154b5d61080e50c9b3b7b4a3 \

  --speculative-config '{

    "enable_adaptive_verification": true,

    "revision": "9c60bcbf1670e06f154b5d61080e50c9b3b7b4a3"
  }' \
  --swa-block-size 128 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
